detail.longDescription:
Find the content you need, return to your work, and catch up on news from across your organization with Microsoft SharePoint.

• Discover what matters to you
Start with Overview to explore relevant files, sites, and news, see updates from people you work with, and pick up where you left off.

• Find information across your organization
Search for files, sites, people, and news. Search within a site to narrow your results and get to the information you need.

• Keep your work close
Quickly return to recently opened content and save important items to Favorites. Browse recent, favorite, and suggested sites, and access their document libraries, lists, and news.

• Read and preview on the go
Read SharePoint pages and news, and preview Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDFs, images, and videos within the app. Open supported files in their dedicated apps when you need to do more.

• Stay connected to people and news
Discover content shared by coworkers, view their profiles, and catch up on news relevant to your work. Filter news to find unread stories or updates from particular sources, and share useful content with others.

• Access your organization’s home site
Open your organization’s home site, when configured, to reach company news and resources alongside your personalized Discover experience.

The experience requires a work or school account with access to SharePoint in Microsoft 365. Available content and features depend on your permissions and your organization’s settings.
